# Deoit — Free Online Code Editor

> Deoit is a free, browser-based code editor for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, file explorer, and live preview. No sign-up required.

## What is Deoit?

Deoit is an online code editor that lets you write, run, and debug HTML, CSS, and JavaScript directly in your browser. It's designed for web development beginners and professionals who want a fast, free alternative to desktop editors.

### Key Features
- Syntax highlighting for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, Markdown
- Smart autocomplete with 500+ built-in keywords
- File explorer with multi-file project support
- Live preview panel (no page refresh)
- 81+ free lessons covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, React, and dev tools
- Chrome extension for quick access
- Embeddable widget for blogs and documentation
- PWA support (installable as desktop app)
- Dark theme editor interface
- No sign-up, no ads, no tracking
